purpose: Generate one bounded deterministic glTF 2.0 binary scene from explicit box, pyramid, and cylinder primitives with fixed transforms and metallic-roughness materials, then re-parse its container, references, ranges, and exact bytes after atomic publication.

properties.path: target .glb file outside the protected live machine body
properties.specification: closed axm.procedural-3d/v0.1 scene with 1 through 128 explicit primitives

contains: exact GLB byte count and SHA-256
node, mesh, material, primitive, and triangle counts
explicit unobserved render and host-import boundaries

relationships: originates exact binary 3D assets without requiring caller-supplied base64 bytes
uses one deterministic glTF scene, node, mesh, material, accessor, bufferView, and buffer grammar
provides reusable GLB bytes to mixed projects, games, websites, viewers, and portable bundles

anatomy_refs.basis: Generates indexed triangle geometry and normals for a closed bounded box, pyramid, and cylinder grammar.
Re-parses every emitted mesh reference, accessor, bufferView, component type, range, count, and draw mode after publication.
Composes explicit named nodes, per-primitive transforms, meshes, and materials into one deterministic scene.
Emits a complete glTF 2.0 GLB container with JSON and BIN chunks and verifies its exact published bytes.

limitations: the first grammar supports only boxes, square pyramids, and straight cylinders with translation and scale; rotation, animation, skins, cameras, lights, textures, UVs, morphs, LODs, physics, and arbitrary mesh import are not implemented
materials contain only one base color plus metallic and roughness factors

container validation proves exact bounded glTF structure and buffer ranges, not rendered appearance, artistic quality, manifold topology, physical correctness, or compatibility with a particular engine or viewer
the maximum is 128 primitives and 64 radial segments per cylinder

truth.basis: The normalized primitive grammar, specification digest, exact asset digest, complete structural receipt, and unobserved rendering/import qualities remain explicit.

agency.basis: The caller chooses every primitive, dimension, translation, material, destination, and replacement decision.

continuity.basis: Publication is atomic, bounded replacement is recoverable if post-publication verification fails, and no machine state is changed.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Strict fields and bounds, glTF chunk structure, references, byte ranges, and exact post-publication bytes are checked before the asset is called validated.
